description: This Short-term Certificate Course is designed to develop skilled professionals in the field of Multiomics Data, creating opportunities for employment and entrepreneurship in sectors such as Health Informatics, Medical Informatics, Life Sciences, and allied industries. The qualification equips learners with advanced knowledge and practical skills in Bioinformatics and Multiomics Data Analytics to enhance their technical competencies and employability. The individual is trained to perform research activities, design and optimize algorithmic models for identification and troubleshooting, improve existing analytical pipelines, and provide scientific and technical support for extracting meaningful insights from biological big data. The role also contributes significantly to the development of future drug discovery platforms.
